wiki.title: Kenny Titus
wiki.extract: Kenny Titus is an American politician. He served as a member of the Kansas House of Representatives from 2023 to 2025, representing the 51st district, then was elected to represent the 18th district in the Kansas Senate in 2024. He is a member of the Republican Party.
